Long, wavy pale pink hair with straight-cut bangs and a soft texture. Large, round light-blue eyes with a mischievous expression. Apparent age is a young teenager with a soft, youthful face. Slim, petite build. Wears a dark navy blue sailor-style school uniform with a white collar and a red ribbon, paired with a short pleated skirt and white calf-high socks. Signature details include a large, ornate black handheld bomb with a lit fuse and a small, pink hair ribbon on the left side of the head.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
